acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:b5c4b58a-.title: Senior Software Engineer, Test Core
acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:b5c4b58a-.description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. Our Senior Software Engineers independently drive complex technical work, shape the systems and technical decisions within their teams, and enable other engineers to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions. Vanta's product monitors the security posture of thousands of companies, pulling tens of millions of API calls of data per day, pushing information from hundreds of thousands of laptop agents, and running tests against that data continuously to identify potential security threats. Our infrastructure and tooling need to stay ahead of exponential growth in our customer base. As a Senior Software Engineer at Vanta, you'll drive complex projects across our technical stack, contribute to the technical direction of your team, and mentor other engineers. Your past experience will be leveraged to enable and accelerate Vanta's growth. Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog https://www.vanta.com/all-categories/engineering to learn more about what our team is working on! Tests are at the heart of how Vanta continuously monitors security and compliance for our customers. The Test Core team builds the runtime platform that powers these checks. We own how Tests are scheduled and executed, how their results are persisted and exposed, and the systems that keep this runtime reliable as Vanta grows. In this role, you'll work on some of the core systems behind Vanta's Tests platform. You'll tackle problems around the reliability, correctness, and performance of Test execution, evolve the systems and abstractions that allow the platform to scale, and make it easier for other engineering teams to build on the Tests runtime. Many of these problems span multiple systems and teams and require a deep understanding of how the platform behaves in production. What you’ll do as a Senior Software Engineer on the Test Core team at Vanta: - Own complex projects from problem definition and technical design through implementation, rollout, and operation - Design and evolve the backend systems, APIs, and data models used to run Tests and process their results - Improve the reliability, correctness, performance, and observability of the Tests runtime - Investigate complex production issues, identify root causes, and build durable solutions - Simplify existing systems and improve the abstractions and interfaces that other engineers build on - Collaborate with engineers across Vanta on problems that span systems and tea - boundaries - Give thoughtful feedback in design and code reviews, communicate technical tradeoffs, and help other engineers make good decisions - Mentor other engineers and contribute to the engineering culture of the team How to be successful in this role: - Have strong experience building and operating reliable, scalable backend systems in production - Have independently delivered complex technical projects where the problem or solution was not always well defined - Have strong systems thinking and fundamentals in backend system design, APIs, and data modeling - Be a strong debugger who can reason about correctness, reliability, performance, and scalability across complex systems - Make effective technical tradeoffs, take ownership of systems in production, and improve mature systems incrementally - Communicate technical decisions clearly, give thoughtful feedback on designs, and collaborate effectively with engineers across teams - Experience with TypeScript, GraphQL, MongoDB, and observability tools such as Datadog is a plus - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficie

foundersfactory-founders-factory:ashbyhq.title: Venture Designer (Singapore)
foundersfactory-founders-factory:ashbyhq.description: About Founders Factory Founders Factory is a venture studio and accelerator backed by some of the world's leading corporations. We combine capital investment with deep operational expertise to build and scale tech companies from scratch. With a portfolio of over 300 companies and $900M+ in follow-on funding, we offer a unique opportunity to shape the future of tech and entrepreneurship - working at the intersection of corporate innovation and startup building. About the Role Venture Design at Founders Factory is how we create new venture concepts on demand, not by chance. Working closely with our corporate partners, you'll take high-level investment themes and turn them into validated, venture-backable concepts through a structured three-month sprint. This is the earliest and most exploratory stage of our venture building process. You'll dig into markets, uncover gaps, conceptualise solutions, and pressure-test them with real users - all before a founder is ever hired. The concepts you validate and present to our Investment Committee become the ventures we go on to build. It's high-impact, high-autonomy work that directly shapes our portfolio. What You'll Do You'll own the end-to-end venture design sprint, working across research, strategy, prototyping, and validation. Specifically, you will: - Take investment themes developed with our corporate partners and break them down into explorable problem spaces and opportunity areas. - Conduct deep market research to understand where sectors are heading, identify structural gaps, and map the competitive landscape. - Generate multiple potential venture concepts from each theme, applying human-centred design principles to conceptualise solutions that address real user needs. - Design and run rapid experiments — including A/B testing, prototype testing, and user interviews — to validate or kill concepts quickly. - Synthesise research and testing into clear, evidence-backed recommendations, narrowing from many ideas to a shortlist of the strongest concepts. - Present validated concepts to the Investment Committee (comprising decision-makers from our corporate backers and the Founders Factory CEO), making a compelling case for which ventures to greenlight. - Collaborate across the studio — working with other Venture Designers, Venture Builders, investors, and functional specialists — to sharpen your thinking and leverage collective expertise. - Stay close to emerging technologies, tools, and market shifts so you're always bringing fresh thinking to each sprint. What We're Looking For - Proven experience in 0→1 concept development, venture design, or similar roles where you've taken ideas from fuzzy opportunity spaces through to validated propositions — ideally across multiple industries or verticals. - Strong strategic thinking combined with a bias for action. You can zoom out to see the big picture and zoom in to run a scrappy experiment in the same afternoon. - Deep comfort with market research and competitive analysis. You know how to find signal in noise and develop a point of view on where a market is going. - Experience designing and running rapid experiments (A/B tests, landing page tests, concierge MVPs, user interviews) to validate assumptions with real users. - Excellent communication and storytelling skills. You'll need to present complex findings and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders with diverse backgrounds. - A curious, creative mind that also brings discipline — you generate lots of ideas but know how to prioritise ruthlessly based on evidence. - Comfort with ambiguity and pace. The sprint format means things move fast and the brief is often wide open. That excites you, not intimidates you. Nice to Have - Fluency in German language - Background in innovation or a venture studio/builder environment. - Experience working with or alongside corporate partners and navigating stakeholder dynamics. - Familiarity with rapid prototyping tools (Figma, no-code/low-code pl

ryzlabs-ryzlabs:lever:38fca784-bc93-4e71.description: Digital Marketing Specialist About the Role We are looking for a highly analytical and driven Digital Marketing Manager to take full ownership of our digital marketing operations and vendor performance. Currently, our paid search campaigns (Google Ads and Local Services Ads) are executed by an external agency (Thryv). This role is not about day-to-day campaign execution from day one; rather, it is about strategic oversight, vendor accountability, lead quality analysis, and ROAS optimization. You will be the internal subject-matter expert who bridges marketing spend with actual booked revenue, making data-backed recommendations on budget allocation and potentially evaluating bringing paid search in-house in the future. Key Responsibilities 1. Vendor Management & Paid Search Oversight • Hold External Partners Accountable: Lead monthly meetings and maintain day-to-day relationship management with our primary paid search vendor (Thryv), overseeing Google Ads and Local Services Ads (LSAs). • Performance & Strategy: Direct priorities, audit keyword strategies, bids, geographies, and budgets to ensure marketing spend yields clear business results. • In-House Potential: Assess performance to determine if and when it makes sense to bring paid search management in-house. 2. Analytics, ROAS & Lead Quality Analysis • ROAS Tracking: Tie marketing/advertising spend directly to booked and invoiced revenue. Build and own performance dashboards and monthly reporting by channel and service line. • Lead Quality Cross-Referencing: Cross-reference vendor lead data (from Thryv and corporate/Invoca) with internal job file conversion data to identify where high-value leads are converting or leaking. • Call Review at Scale (AI-Driven): Monitor inbound call handling and intake quality. Leverage modern AI transcription and analysis tools to analyze call quality efficiently and repeatedly, minimizing manual listening while identifying gaps in lead conversion. 3. Google Business Profile & Review Management • Profile Ownership: Oversee Google Business Profiles across all franchise locations—handling verification issues, category setup, service areas, hours, and photos. • Reviews & Disputes: Drive review generation across field teams, handle review responses, and manage disputes/removal requests for inappropriate reviews in coordination with corporate/SEO partners. 4. Microsite & Content Optimization • Website Ownership: Maintain and refresh our microsite content for each franchise (services offered, target cities, testimonials, landing pages). • Conversion & SEO: Ensure service pages are optimized for searchability and conversion, directly impacting paid search efficiency and organic performance. Candidate Profile & Requirements • Experience: 2–3 years of solid, hands-on experience in digital marketing roles. • Paid Search & SEO Fluency: Strong working knowledge of Google Ads, Local Services Ads (LSAs), Google Business Profiles, and local SEO strategies. • Analytical Mindset: Comfortable conducting spreadsheet-level ROAS analysis, cross-referencing datasets, and translating raw data into actionable business recommendations. • Vendor Oversight: Prior experience or strong comfort managing marketing agency relationships, holding them accountable to KPIs. • AI & Tech Savvy: Up-to-date with modern AI tools (especially for transcription, call analysis, or workflow automation) and eager to leverage tech to streamline processes. • Soft Skills: Adaptable, highly organized, proactive, and capable of operating as an independent single-point-of-contact for digital marketing.

southparkcommons-inco:bamboohr:35.description: Senior Frontend Engineer About Inco Inco is building the confidentiality layer for blockchains through encryption technologies. We’re building the next generation of secure, scalable, and privacy-enhancing solutions for Web3, enabling fintech, payments, and blockchain applications to have the same confidentiality and capabilities users expect from Web2. Who You Are We’re looking for a senior frontend engineer who has built production-grade Web3 user experiences and understands the unique complexity of blockchain applications. You have strong frontend fundamentals, but you also understand that Web3 frontend engineering is not just about building interfaces. It requires safely fetching and interpreting onchain data, integrating wallets, handling signatures, managing client-side state, and designing user flows where security and correctness matter. You should be comfortable building polished, reliable UIs while also thinking deeply about how users interact with wallets, sign messages, grant permissions, manage session keys, and execute intent-based flows. You understand the security risks of asking users to sign transactions or messages, and you care about making those flows clear, safe, and difficult to misuse. We’re looking for someone senior who can own frontend architecture end-to-end, raise engineering standards, and mentor more junior engineers. You should be the type of person who can turn ambiguous product requirements into secure, elegant, production-ready user experiences. This role is remote / hybrid / based in Bangalore (preferred). Responsibilities Frontend Architecture & Development Design, build, and maintain production-grade frontend applications using modern frontend technologies. Own frontend features end-to-end, from product requirements and UX flows to implementation, testing, and deployment. Build responsive, performant, and reliable user interfaces for Web3 products. Create reusable frontend components, patterns, and architecture that allow the team to move quickly without sacrificing quality. Work closely with product, design, backend, and protocol teams to translate complex Web3 flows into intuitive user experiences. Web3 Product & Wallet Integration Build frontend experiences that integrate with wallets, smart contracts, indexers, RPC providers, and blockchain data sources. Implement flows involving transaction signing, message signing, intent signing, session keys, delegated permissions, and account abstraction. Design user experiences around balances, transaction history, onchain transactions, permissions, and Web3 payment flows. Understand how to fetch, cache, reconcile, and display onchain and offchain data safely and accurately. Handle edge cases common in Web3 applications, including pending transactions, reorgs, failed RPC calls, wallet disconnects, chain switching, stale balances, and inconsistent indexer data. Security & Correctness Ensure frontend flows are secure by default, especially when users are asked to sign messages, authorize intents, or store session keys locally. Apply best practices for client-side key management, session key storage, permission scoping, signature domain separation, and phishing-resistant UX. Work with the team to identify and prevent risks around malicious signatures, replay attacks, unsafe approvals, incorrect transaction previews, and confusing wallet prompts. Treat frontend correctness as critical infrastructure, especially when user funds or private information are involved. Leadership & Mentorship Lead technical design discussions and help define frontend architecture, standards, and best practices. Review code and mentor junior engineers on frontend quality, Web3 security, testing, and production readiness. Improve engineering velocity by building strong abstractions, documentation, and internal tooling. Take ownership of frontend quality across performance, reliability, security, accessibility, and maintainability. Required Experience 5+ years of frontend eng

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:4fd2c451-fe6.title: Hydrus - Voice Contributor - Swiss German (CH)
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:4fd2c451-fe6.description: Description About the Project We're looking for native-level Swiss German (CH) speakers with professional voice recording experience to join the Hydrus Project. The project consists of two scheduled recording sessions from their own home studio. Because the recordings go straight into production, the audition validates two things equally: your voice and your recording environment. What You'll Do Audition with two 30 second samples using your home studio set up Once approved, you will complete two scheduled recording sessions of approximately 4 hours each Participate in natural conversation, prompted discussion, and scripted customer-service scenarios Record from your own home studio setup across both sessions Your Recording Environment Three things are required, and each is judged separately: An external microphone: A separate, dedicated microphone is absolutely required — see below. A dry room: Your voice should sound close and clear, with no echo or hollow, distant quality. Untreated rooms with bare walls, hard floors, and high ceilings usually fail. A quiet room: No HVAC hum, fans, traffic, appliances, or household noise during recording. Minimum Required Gear Dynamic Mics (best for untreated rooms): Shure SM58, Shure MV7 / MV7+, RODE PodMic / PodMic USB, or similar. Condenser mic (great in a treated room): RODE NT-USB Mini, Blue Yeti / Yeti Orb, Blue Bluebird, Blue Baby Bottle, or similar. Room Treatment: Your recording space should produce studio-quality sound samples – isolation shields, sounds absorbing pads, etc… Immediately rejected: built-in laptop microphones, phone mics, AirPods, Samsung Buds, headphone-attached mics, headsets, and gaming headsets. Technical Specification You must be able to produce audio samples in the meeting the following specifications: WAV format, 24-bit, 48 kHz, no compression. Free software such as Audacity can produce this. If you cannot export in this format, please do not apply — this level of technicality is required for this role. Who We're Looking For Native-level Swiss German (CH) speaker A natural, authentic, friendly, conversational customer-service speaking style A dry, quiet home recording space and a professional microphone, as described above Good background, but not required: Podcasters, youtubers, streamers, recording artists, voice-over actors, etc – anyone who has experience recording audio in a high-quality home studio Commitment & Compensation Estimated time: approximately 8 hours total across two scheduled sessions Compensation: $65.00 USD per hour
